entries.english: A restless essence of a once living thing...

entries.english: This is the stuff of life, the poison that consumes itself. The Dvergr refine it to use in their esoteric designs.
entries.irish: Is é seo an stuif den saol, an nimh a itheann féin. Déanann an Dvergr é a scagadh chun é a úsáid ina ndearaí esoteric.

entries.english: The fur is dense, coarse, and surprisingly clean.
entries.irish: Tá an fionnadh dlúth, garbh, agus go hiontach glan.

entries.english: A slimy length of something's insides.

entries.english: Every flying ember is a burning wish to repent.
entries.irish: Tá gach ember eitilt mian dhó a repent.

entries.english: It's hard to tell whether the steam coming off of this dish is because it's freshly cooked or because of the asksvin meat in it. Either way, the spiced meat together with the vineberries and fiddlehead sprouts is so delicious that it doesn't matter!
entries.irish: Tá sé deacair a rá an bhfuil an gaile ag teacht as an mhias seo toisc go bhfuil sé cócaráilte go húire nó mar gheall ar an fheoil asksvin ann. Ceachtar slí, tá an fheoil spiced mar aon leis na fíniúnacha agus na sprouts fidile chomh blasta nach bhfuil sé ábhar!

entries.english: You won't be able to resist this platter of delights from the Black Forest! Venison sirloin steaks are served together with spiced thistles and carrots, and the whole meal is tied together with delicious jams. Just have one more bite!
entries.irish: Ní bheidh tú in ann seasamh in aghaidh an platter de delights ó na Foraoise Dubh! Déantar stéigeanna sirloin a sheirbheáil in éineacht le thistles agus cairéid spiced, agus tá an béile iomlán ceangailte le subh delicious. Just a bhfuil ceann amháin níos mó bite!

entries.english: Warming and filling, this meal will sustain you even during the coldest of days. Porridge and pancakes pair well with jams and sausages, making it hard not to come back for a second helping!
entries.irish: Téamh agus líonadh, beidh an béile a chothú tú fiú le linn na laethanta is fuaire. Porridge agus pancóga péire maith le subh agus ispíní, rud a chiallaíonn sé deacair gan teacht ar ais le haghaidh an dara cuidiú!

entries.english: A boar that has been roasted to perfection, glazed and served atop a bed of greens, with additional cuts of meat on the side. A feast like this is sure to fill your stomach and brighten your day!
entries.irish: Torc a róstadh chun foirfeachta, a gloiníodh agus a seirbheáladh ar bharr leaba ghlas, le gearrthacha breise feola ar an taobh. Is cinnte go líonfaidh féasta mar seo do bholg agus go ngealfaidh sé do lá!
Seomraí Mushrooms Galore á la Mistlands

entries.english: The time has come for mushroom enthusiasts to rejoice! Try different kinds of mushrooms, mushroom marinated seeker meat and mushroom-filled misthare, and don't miss out on the tasty sap dressing.
entries.irish: Tá an t-am teacht le haghaidh díograiseoirí beacán a rejoice! Bain triail as cineálacha éagsúla beacán, marinated beacán feola iarrthóir agus misthare beacán-líonadh, agus ná caill amach ar an cóiriú sap blasta.

entries.english: Gather around this steaming pot full of deliciousness and warm yourselves up again after a day out in the cold. The usually tough and chewey wolf meat has become tender enough to practically melt in your mouth, and the onions and carrots are made even tastier with exciting spices.
entries.irish: Bailigh thart ar an bpota steaming iomlán de deliciousness agus te díbh féin suas arís tar éis lá amach sa fuar. De ghnáth tá feoil mac tíre diana agus chewey tar éis éirí tairisceana go leor chun leá go praiticiúil i do bhéal, agus déantar na oinniúin agus na cairéid fiú níos blasta le spíosraí spreagúil.

entries.english: Fish, fish, and more fish! And also serpent meat, cut to look like fish! Explore the flavours of the Ocean, along with some grilled greens for those still practicing their sea legs.
entries.irish: Éisc, iasc, agus iasc níos mó! Agus freisin feoil nathair, gearrtha chun breathnú cosúil le iasc! Déan iniúchadh ar bhlastáin an Aigéin, chomh maith le roinnt greens grilled dóibh siúd fós ag cleachtadh a cosa farraige.

entries.english: There's nothing plain about this feast! Enjoy pies and loaves fresh from the oven, both sweet and savoury, and experience the culinary equivalent of a hug.
entries.irish: Níl aon rud plain mar gheall ar an feast! Bain sult as cóipeanna agus loaves úr ón oigheann, idir milis agus blasta, agus taithí a fháil ar an coibhéiseach cócaireachta de barróg.

entries.english: Who knew that leeches were edible? With the correct preparation (lots of cooking and lots of seasoning) you will be able to serve them in this feast for the culinary brave. For those who have a sensitive stomach, there are also tasty skewers of sausages and turnips on the side.
entries.irish: Cé a fhios go raibh leeches inite? Leis an ullmhú ceart (liotáin de chócaireacht agus go leor de seasoning) beidh tú in ann chun freastal orthu sa feast do na cróga cócaireachta. Dóibh siúd a bhfuil boilg íogair, tá skewers blasta de ispíní agus torna ar an taobh.

entries.english: This musty stew is a necessity on every adventurer's menu.
entries.irish: Is é seo an stew musty riachtanas ar gach roghchlár fiontaróir ar.

entries.english: This bait doesn't look like much, but it's a treat to fish that live where it's cold and dark.

entries.english: It's not very nutritious, so the only fish that'll take this bait are the ones that are used to just eating ice.
entries.irish: Níl sé an-chothaitheach, mar sin is iad an t-iasc amháin a thógfaidh an bhaoite seo na cinn a úsáidtear chun oighir a ithe.

entries.english: Common dvergr fishing bait. Fishing rod sold separately.
entries.irish: Baoite iascaireachta coitianta dvergr. Slat iascaireachta a dhíoltar ar leithligh.

entries.english: Dead trolls in the forest often attract a fish or two, speed up the process with this bait!

entries.english: You're not immune to deathsquito bites, and the fish here aren't immune to this snack!

entries.english: It might smell foul, but the fish drawn to this bait are used to so much worse.
entries.irish: D'fhéadfadh sé boladh bréan, ach úsáidtear an t-iasc a tharraingt chuig an mbaoite seo chun an oiread sin níos measa.

entries.english: Bread and fish, what more to wish?

entries.irish: Caithfear íobairt bheag a dhéanamh do gach cath...

entries.english: Split your enemies' hearts in two.
entries.irish: Scoil do naimhde' gcroí i dhá.

entries.english: Let the crack of thunder split the air.
entries.irish: Lig an scoilt de thoir scoilt an t-aer.

entries.english: Nature's forces burst through the ground wherever this spear strikes.
entries.irish: fórsaí Nádúr pléasctha tríd an talamh cibé áit stailceanna spear.

entries.english: Even in death, the wolf's tooth aches for flesh.
entries.irish: Fiú amháin i bás, aches fiacail an mac tíre le haghaidh flesh.

entries.english: This is just as sharp as a real spear, if a real spear was made out of wood.
entries.irish: Tá sé seo ach chomh géar mar spear fíor, má rinneadh spear fíor as adhmad.
An bhfuil a fhios agat na buntáistí a bhaineann...

entries.english: Whatever spices have been used in this blend, they must come from someplace hot. And as if that wasn't enough, they have also been dried and smoked before being ground into a fine powder.
entries.irish: Cibé spíosraí a úsáideadh sa chumasc seo, ní mór dóibh teacht ó áit éigin te. Agus mar más rud é nach raibh go leor, tá siad triomaithe agus deataithe freisin roimh a bheith talamh i púdar fíneáil.

entries.english: Using cinnamon bark and ginger root, with a touch of nutmeg, the herbalist has travelled far to create this fine and warming blend of spices.
entries.irish: Ag baint úsáide as coirt cainéal agus fréimhe ginger, le teagmháil nutmeg, tá an luibheoir thaistil i bhfad chun an meascán fíneáil agus téamh de spíosraí a chruthú.

entries.english: Thyme and marjoram carefully harvested and dried, before being mixed together. This blend will turn even the most basic of ingredients into a delicious feast.
entries.irish: Thyme agus marjoram fómhar agus triomaithe go cúramach, sula measctha le chéile. Beidh an meascán cas fiú an chuid is mó bunúsach de chomhábhair i feast delicious.

entries.english: A good herbalist knows exactly where to go to find ramsons, but she won't tell you the secrets of her trade! Still, if you have the coin for it you may treat yourself to this blend of finely harvested ramson bulbs and leaves.
entries.irish: Tá a fhios ag luibheoir maith go díreach cá háit le dul chun ramsons a aimsiú, ach ní inseoidh sí rúin a trádála duit! Fós féin, má tá an bonn agat dó b'fhéidir go gcaithfeá féin leis an meascán seo de bholgáin agus duilleoga ramson mínbhuainte.

entries.english: Only the most seasoned herbalist can find the pepperwood tree and harvest its leaves and bark. After careful preparation it's ready to be added to food, and is sure to give it some warming heat.
entries.irish: Ní féidir ach an luibheoir is séasúraí teacht ar an gcrann piobar agus a duilleoga agus a choirt a fhómhar. Tar éis ullmhú go cúramach tá sé réidh le cur le bia, agus tá sé cinnte a thabhairt dó roinnt teas téamh.

entries.english: The sour tang of sorrel, mixed with something the herbalist would rather not disclose, is well suitable for fish. Any fisherfolk worth their salt would do well to keep this blend near, in case of a good catch!
entries.irish: Tá an tang géar sorrel, measctha le rud éigin nach nochtfadh an luibheach, oiriúnach go maith d'iasc. Bheadh aon fisherfolk fiú a gcuid salann a dhéanamh go maith a choinneáil ar an meascán in aice, i gcás ghabháil maith!

entries.english: This blend utilises all aspects of the lovage plant, a rarity in the tenth world. Roots, leaves and seeds have all been gathered, and then mixed together in the perfect quantity.
entries.irish: Úsáideann an meascán seo gach gné den ghléasra grá, rarity sa domhan deichiú. Tá fréamhacha, duilleoga agus síolta bailithe go léir, agus ansin measctha le chéile sa chainníocht foirfe.

entries.english: Sugary honey perfectly balanced with tangy fronds and tart berries.
entries.irish: Mil iomarcach cothrom go foirfe le fronds tangy agus caora tart.

entries.english: A caged snowflake, endless patterns emerging from within...
entries.irish: A snowflake caged, patrúin endless ag teacht chun cinn ó laistigh...

entries.english: What happens next may shock you.
entries.irish: Cad a tharlaíonn seo chugainn d'fhéadfadh turraing tú.

entries.english: A chill that goes right through to the bone.
entries.irish: Chill a théann díreach tríd go dtí an cnámh.

entries.english: This magical item needs to be hardened with frost.
entries.irish: Ní mór an mhír draíochta seo a bheith cruaite le sioc.

entries.english: Summon otherworldly aid. It only costs a drop of your blood...
entries.irish: Summon cúnamh otherworldly. Ní chosnaíonn sé ach titim de do chuid fola...

entries.english: This magical item needs to be hardened with frost.
entries.irish: Ní mór an mhír draíochta seo a bheith cruaite le sioc.

entries.english: Simply point, and you shall summon the wrath of the sky.
entries.irish: Níl ort ach pointe, agus beidh tú a thoghairm an wrath an spéir.

entries.english: This magical item needs to be hardened with frost.
entries.irish: Ní mór an mhír draíochta seo a bheith cruaite le sioc.

entries.english: Only those with patience and focus will be able to harness the true power of this staff.
entries.irish: Ní bheidh ach iad siúd a bhfuil foighne agus fócas in ann leas a bhaint as an chumhacht fíor na foirne seo.

entries.english: The sweltering heat of Muspelheim seems almost pathetic when compared to what this staff can do...
entries.irish: Dealraíonn an teas sweltering de Muspelheim beagnach pathetic i gcomparáid leis an méid is féidir leis an bhfoireann a dhéanamh...

entries.english: Ancient natural forces lie curled and dormant within this staff, ready to be unleashed.
entries.irish: Luíonn fórsaí nádúrtha ársa cuachta agus díomhaoin laistigh den fhoireann seo, réidh le bheith scaoilte.

entries.english: A staff as cold as the three-year winter that will herald the end of times.
entries.irish: Foireann chomh fuar leis an ngeimhreadh trí bliana a dhéanfaidh gaisce faoi dheireadh na n - amanna.

entries.english: What happens next may shock you.
entries.irish: Cad a tharlaíonn seo chugainn d'fhéadfadh turraing tú.

entries.english: Summons a raging beast to cause death and destruction.
entries.irish: Summons Beast raging a chur faoi deara bás agus scrios.

entries.english: For a slight blood offering it will protect the caster in a magical shell.
entries.irish: Le haghaidh a thairiscint fola beag beidh sé a chosaint ar an caster i bhlaosc draíochta.

entries.english: Sacrifice a bit of blood to raise the dead. Upgrade the skull to spawn multiple skeletons, and increase your blood magic to make them stronger.
entries.irish: Íobairt le beagán de fola a ardú na marbh. Uasghrádú an cloigeann a sceith cnámharlaigh éagsúla, agus do draíochta fola a mhéadú chun iad a dhéanamh níos láidre.

entries.english: A weapon worthy of the Gods! If you get hit with this, you'll know it...
entries.irish: Arm ar fiú na Déithe é! Má bhuaileann tú leis seo, beidh a fhios agat é...

entries.english: Anyone wielding this weapon is sure to be very frightening indeed.
entries.irish: Tá duine ar bith wielding an arm cinnte a bheith an - scanrúil go deimhin.

entries.english: The same mould, yet inclined to yield a more spectacular result... The frost shall reveal all, in time.
entries.irish: An múnla céanna, ach claonadh chun toradh níos iontach a thabhairt... Nochtfaidh an sioc go léir, in am.

entries.english: A striking weapon, both visually and lethally.
entries.irish: Arm buailte, amhairc agus marfach araon.

entries.english: The choice between a fiery end and a frozen one is simple: Both at the same time.
entries.irish: Is é an rogha idir deireadh fiery agus ceann reoite simplí: An dá ag an am céanna.

entries.english: The same mould, yet inclined to yield a more spectacular result... The frost shall reveal all, in time.
entries.irish: An múnla céanna, ach claonadh chun toradh níos iontach a thabhairt... Nochtfaidh an sioc go léir, in am.

entries.english: This weapon needs to be hardened with frost.
entries.irish: Ní mór an t-arm seo a chruachadh le sioc.

entries.english: A thing of death and beauty. It catches the light with a greenish glow.
entries.irish: Rud an bháis agus na háilleachta. Gabhann sé an solas le glow greenish.

entries.english: The sword that was broken is whole once more. Its flames burn hot, fuelled by the memories of ancient warriors.
entries.irish: Is é an claíomh a briseadh go hiomlán uair amháin níos mó. A lasracha sruthán te, bhreoslaithe ag na cuimhní laochra ársa.

entries.english: Unsheathed, it sizzles and spits with deathless fire, an impossible blade.
entries.irish: Unsheathed, sizzles sé agus spits le tine deathless, lann dodhéanta.

entries.english: As the blood runs along the blade, it awakens the storm within.
entries.irish: De réir mar a ritheann an fhuil ar feadh na lainne, dúisíonn sé an stoirm laistigh.

entries.english: The same mould, yet inclined to yield a more spectacular result... The frost shall reveal all, in time.
entries.irish: An múnla céanna, ach claonadh chun toradh níos iontach a thabhairt... Nochtfaidh an sioc go léir, in am.

entries.english: Even in the faintest sunlight, this weapon glimmers.
entries.irish: Fiú amháin sa solas is laige, glimmers arm seo.

entries.english: Flames dance along this blade, but are they hot or cold?
entries.irish: Flames rince feadh an lann, ach tá siad te nó fuar?

entries.english: The same mould, yet inclined to yield a more spectacular result... The frost shall reveal all, in time.
entries.irish: An múnla céanna, ach claonadh chun toradh níos iontach a thabhairt... Nochtfaidh an sioc go léir, in am.

entries.english: This weapon needs to be hardened with frost.
entries.irish: Ní mór an t-arm seo a chruachadh le sioc.

entries.english: The straight line between life and death runs along the edge of this blade.
entries.irish: Ritheann an líne dhíreach idir an saol agus an bás ar imeall an lann seo.

entries.english: As deadly as it is shiny, and it's very shiny.
entries.irish: Chomh marbh is atá sé lonrach, agus tá sé an - lonrach.

entries.english: The faint glow seems to slice through the mist.
entries.irish: Dealraíonn an Glow faint a slice tríd an olc.

entries.english: If you bleed, your foes are sure to do so as well.
entries.irish: Má bleed tú, tá do foes cinnte a dhéanamh chomh maith.

entries.english: Named after the evil dragon that dwells by the roots of the world tree, this sword heralds doom for those who cross its path.
entries.irish: Ainmnithe tar éis an dragan olc a dwells ag na fréamhacha an chrainn ar fud an domhain, seo heralds claíomh doom dóibh siúd a thrasnú a cosán.

entries.english: The power of lightning dances along the blade of this sword, a promise of the pain to come.
entries.irish: An chumhacht na damhsaí lightning ar feadh an lann an claíomh, gealltanas an pian atá le teacht.

entries.english: Tangle your foes in roots, like the namesake of this blade.
entries.irish: Tangle do foes i fréamhacha, cosúil leis an namesake an lann.

entries.english: Purest of metals, nothing unclean can abide its touch.
entries.irish: Purest de mhiotail, is féidir aon rud neamhghlan abide a dteagmháil.

entries.english: If it bleeds, you can kill it.
entries.irish: Má bleeds sé, is féidir leat é a mharú.

entries.english: This mighty blade thirsts for the blood of foes.
entries.irish: Tart an lann mighty le haghaidh an fhuil na foes.

entries.english: The lightning bound into this blade is erratic, ever searching for something to strike.
entries.irish: Is é an tintreach faoi cheangal isteach an lann seo erratic, riamh cuardach le haghaidh rud éigin a bhaint amach.

entries.english: The blade works in tandem with the primal forces of the world, seeking death and slaughter.
entries.irish: Oibríonn an lann in éineacht leis na fórsaí primal an domhain, ag lorg bás agus marú.

entries.english: Would you be careful with that, please?
entries.irish: Ar mhaith leat a bheith cúramach leis sin, le do thoil?

entries.english: Mostly harmless, unless you're very persistent.
entries.irish: An chuid is mó harmless, ach amháin má tá tú an-mharthanach.
Ní féidir ach créatúir tamed ghortú.

entries.english: One year since we arrived... Skål!
entries.irish: Bliain amháin ó tháinig muid... Staidéar!

entries.english: Oden's finest warriors deserve the finest drinks.
entries.irish: Oden laochra is fearr ag dul na deochanna is fearr.
Tá sé ag cnagadh le fuinneamh.

entries.english: A bar of pure tin ready to be worked.
entries.irish: Beár stáin íon réidh le hoibriú.

entries.english: Unrefined tin. Needs to be refined in a smelter.
entries.irish: Stáin neamhchinnte. Riachtanais a scagadh i smelter.

entries.english: It brings light and warmth, drives back the darkness.
entries.irish: Tugann sé solas agus teas, thiomáineann ar ais ar an dorchadas.

entries.english: Your mind hardens, as do your blows.
entries.irish: Do aigne hardens, mar a dhéanann do blows.

entries.english: Dance with death as you dodge your enemies' strikes.
entries.irish: Rince le bás mar dodge tú do naimhde' stailceanna.

entries.english: Claw and bone and gold – grant them blood and they shall grant you a boon.
entries.irish: Claw agus cnámh agus ór – iad a dheonú fola agus beidh siad a dheonú duit boon.

entries.english: They say that the soul of a witch can grant strange powers to mortals...
entries.irish: Deir siad gur féidir leis an anam medicine cumhachtaí aisteach a dheonú do mortals...

entries.english: It pulsates with fragments of ancient life.
entries.irish: pulsates sé le blúirí den saol ársa.

entries.english: A beautiful pendant, harbouring the endurance of a bear.
entries.irish: A pendant álainn, harbouring an endurance de béar.

entries.english: If you listen carefully, you can hear the faint echoes of lost souls...
entries.irish: Má tá tú ag éisteacht go cúramach, is féidir leat a chloisteáil na macallaí faint de anamacha caillte...

entries.english: Empty your mind as you become shapeless and one with the water.
entries.irish: Folamh d'intinn mar a bheith tú shapeless agus ceann leis an uisce.

entries.english: It's warm, as if filled with a lifesblood of its own.
entries.irish: Tá sé te, amhail is dá mba líonadh le lifesblood dá chuid féin.

entries.english: Puts a spring in your step!
A razor-sharp ankle chain. Can it truly be comfortable?
entries.irish: A slabhra rúitín rásúr - géar. An féidir é a bheith fíor - chompordach?

entries.english: Assume the sharp and furious mind of a wolf.
entries.irish: Glac leis an aigne géar agus ar buile mac tíre.

entries.english: A shard of frozen sorrow. Touching it makes you feel almost numb.
entries.irish: Siord de bhrón reoite. Teagmháil a dhéanann sé bhraitheann tú beagnach numb.

entries.english: A thick and sturdy hide. This is why trolls are so hard to kill.
entries.irish: A cheilt tiubh agus sturdy. Sin é an fáth go bhfuil trolls chomh deacair a mharú.

entries.english: A tangled mess of roots and bark.
entries.irish: Tá praiseach tangled de fréamhacha agus coirt.

entries.english: It's been dead so long that it started living again.
entries.irish: Tá sé marbh chomh fada agus a thosaigh sé ag maireachtáil arís.

entries.english: Don't let yourself be fooled by the friendly smile, for it could easily bite your arm off.
entries.irish: Ná lig tú féin a bheith fooled ag an aoibh gháire cairdiúil, d'fhéadfadh sé a bite go héasca do lámh as.

entries.english: A mighty beast, but now it shall roam no more.
entries.irish: A Beast mighty, ach anois beidh sé roam nach bhfuil níos mó.

entries.english: The frozen head of a once-living tree.
A forest creature, metamorphosed into living frost.
entries.irish: Créatúr foraoise, meiteamorfach ina shioc beo.
Is é sin stare fós scanrúil...

entries.english: Mistakenly, it believed itself the master of the forest.
entries.irish: Mistakenly, chreid sé féin an máistir na foraoise.

entries.english: These eyes are finally vacant for good.
entries.irish: Tá na súile folamh ar deireadh le haghaidh maith.

entries.english: The most dreaded shadow of the night.
entries.irish: An scáth is dreaded ar an oíche.

entries.english: A smelly lump of sticky matter.
It's like a shard of ice, only...slimy?
entries.irish: Tá sé cosúil le shard oighir, ach... caol?

entries.english: No matter the passage of time, it remains frozen.
entries.irish: Is cuma an sliocht ama, tá sé reoite.

entries.english: Even now, it's burning hot to the touch.
entries.irish: Fiú anois, tá sé ag dó te leis an dteagmháil.

entries.english: Remains of unfortunate adventurers, digested and jellified over time.
entries.irish: Taisí de fiontaróirí trua, digested agus jellified le himeacht ama.

entries.english: It still jiggles, but you're fairly certain that it's dead.
entries.irish: Tá sé fós míreanna mearaí, ach tá tú cinnte go bhfuil sé marbh.

entries.english: This boar head would make for a nice decoration in any house.
entries.irish: Bheadh an ceann boar a dhéanamh le haghaidh maisiú deas in aon teach.

entries.english: Any viking worth their axe should know how to slay a boar.
entries.irish: Ba chóir go mbeadh a fhios ag aon viking fiú a tua conas torc a mharú.

entries.english:
Bones and viscous goo, held together by some unseen force.

Offer it to the Sacrificial Stones.
entries.irish:
Bones agus goo slaodach, ar siúl le chéile ag roinnt fórsa unseen.

Déan é a thairiscint do na Clocha Íobairt.

entries.english: A mess of black soil and old bone, thankfully quiet now.
entries.irish: Praiseach d'ithir dhubh agus de sheanchnámh, buíochas le Dia ciúin anois.

entries.english: A skull made up of dense bone, as dangerous as it is protective.
entries.irish: Cloigeann déanta suas de chnámh dlúth, chomh contúirteach is atá sé cosantach.

entries.english: These jagged teeth had been the death of many a seafarer, before the beast finally met its own end.
entries.irish: Bhí na fiacla jagged an bás go leor maraithe, roimh bhuail an Beast ar deireadh a deireadh féin.

entries.english: The younger of two brothers. Jealous of his brother's magic.
entries.irish: An óige de bheirt deartháireacha. Jealous draíochta a dheartháir.

entries.english: These legs could hold infinite power.
entries.irish: D'fhéadfadh na cosa a shealbhú cumhacht gan teorainn.
Marches an saighdiúir seo níos mó.

entries.english: A warm glow seems to almost emanate from within. Handle with care.
entries.irish: Is cosúil go n - eascraíonn glow te beagnach ón taobh istigh. Láimhseáil go cúramach.

entries.english: If you listen closely, you can still hear the faint hum of magic.
entries.irish: Má tá tú ag éisteacht go dlúth, is féidir leat a chloisteáil fós ar an hum faint de draíochta.

entries.english: Fractures line this skull, as if it has taken many hits over the years.
entries.irish: Fractures líne seo cloigeann, mar má tá sé tógtha amas go leor thar na blianta.

entries.english: Even in death, its gaze is unrelenting.
entries.irish: Fiú amháin i bás, tá a gaze gan staonadh.

entries.english: My, what big teeth it has...
entries.irish: Mo, cad fiacla mór tá sé...

entries.english: He's giving you an icy stare.
entries.irish: Tá sé ag tabhairt tú stare icy.

entries.english: Isolated from his kin for embracing the white frost instead of resisting it.
entries.irish: Isolated as a kin chun glacadh leis an sioc bán in ionad a seasamh in aghaidh é.

entries.english: The fire in its eyes has still not burned out.
entries.irish: Níl an tine ina súile dóite fós amach.

entries.english: You don't like touching this thing even when it's dead.
entries.irish: Ní maith leat touching an rud seo fiú nuair a tá sé marbh.

entries.english: It's strange that we should suffer so much over so small a thing.
entries.irish: Tá sé aisteach gur chóir dúinn ag fulaingt an oiread sin níos mó ná sin beag rud.

entries.english: A fine specimen, but you'll need to kill more than deer to enter Valhalla.
entries.irish: A eiseamal breá, ach beidh ort a mharú níos mó ná fianna chun dul isteach Valhalla.

entries.english: Seemingly identical to the ones found in Midgard.
entries.irish: Seemingly comhionann leis na cinn le fáil i Midgard.

entries.english:
The head of a dragon, majestic even in the rigor of death.

Offer it to the Sacrificial Stones.
entries.irish:
An ceann de Dragon, maorga fiú i rigor an bháis.

Déan é a thairiscint do na Clocha Íobairt.

entries.english: Scored with ancient scars, this head was the last sight of countless warriors.
entries.irish: Scortha le scars ársa, bhí an ceann an radharc deireanach de laochra countless.

entries.english: Bind up the mouth if it starts to whisper in the night...
entries.irish: Ceangail suas an béal má thosaíonn sé a whisper san oíche...

entries.english: What should have been left to rest in peace has been awoken, twisted and corrupted.
entries.irish: Cad ba chóir a bheith fágtha chun sosa a bhí awoken, twisted agus truaillithe.

entries.english: The dead stare of the glowing red eyes sends a shiver through your bones.
entries.irish: Cuireann an stare marbh de na súile dearg glowing shiver trí do chnámha.

entries.english: Perhaps this was once a mighty warrior, worthy of praise. Now it is but a rotten, horrid corpse.
entries.irish: B'fhéidir go raibh sé seo uair amháin ina laoch mighty, fiú moladh. Anois tá sé ach rotten, horrid corpse.

entries.english: It's frankly a little troubling that you would consider hanging these on your wall...
entries.irish: Tá sé frankly troubling beag go mbeadh tú a mheas crochta na ar do bhalla...

entries.english:
This severed head oozes power.

Offer it to the Sacrificial Stones.
entries.irish:
Seo oozes ceann déine cumhachta.

Déan é a thairiscint do na Clocha Íobairt.

entries.english: Once the king of the forest, the size of the antlers is truly impressive.
entries.irish: Nuair a bheidh an rí na foraoise, is é an méid de na antlers fíor go hiontach.

entries.english: Mean little eyes stare back at you.
entries.irish: Mean súile beag stare ar ais ag tú.

entries.english: Was it driven by cruelty or mischief? We may never know.
entries.irish: An raibh sé tiomáinte ag cruálacht nó mischief? Ní féidir linn a fhios.

entries.english:
This severed head oozes power.

Offer it to the Sacrificial Stones.
entries.irish:
Seo oozes ceann déine cumhachta.

Déan é a thairiscint do na Clocha Íobairt.

entries.english: Even in death, it seems to grin with secret knowledge.
entries.irish: Fiú amháin i bás, is cosúil go grin le eolas rúnda.

entries.english:
The green dragon, corrupted beyond redemption.

Offer him to the sacrificial stones.
entries.irish:
An dragan glas, truaillithe thar fhuascailt.

Tairiscint dó go dtí na clocha íobartach.

entries.english: Only tatters remained of his sane mind. Perhaps it was a mercy to kill him.
entries.irish: Ach tatters fhan a aigne sane. B'fhéidir go raibh sé trócaire a mharú dó.

entries.english: Though she is dead, she yearns for the blood to flow.
entries.irish: Cé go bhfuil sí marbh, yearns sí don fhuil a sreabhadh.

entries.english: Once a fierce and noble being, before she was warped into a harbinger of terror.
entries.irish: Nuair a bheith fíochmhar agus uasal, sula raibh sí warped i harbinger terror.

entries.english: A strange, elongated paw, its claws razor sharp.
entries.irish: A aisteach, fadálach lapa, a crúba rásúr géar.

entries.english: Halfway between wolf and man, forever frozen in a snarl of pain.
entries.irish: Leathbhealach idir mac tíre agus fear, go deo reoite i snarl pian.

entries.english: The leathery skin bears the faded tracery of ancient symbols.
entries.irish: Bears an craiceann leathair an rianaithe faded na siombailí ársa.

entries.english: The leathery skin bears the faded tracery of ancient symbols.
entries.irish: Bears an craiceann leathair an rianaithe faded na siombailí ársa.

entries.english: The eyes still glitter and swirl with silvery flecks. Don't look into them for too long...
entries.irish: Na súile fós glitter agus swirl le flecks silvery. Ná breathnú isteach orthu ar feadh ró-fhada...

entries.english: The eyes still glitter and swirl with silvery flecks. Don't look into them for too long...
entries.irish: Na súile fós glitter agus swirl le flecks silvery. Ná breathnú isteach orthu ar feadh ró-fhada...

entries.english: Does it still whisper about unfinished business?
entries.irish: An bhfuil sé fós whisper faoi ghnó neamhchríochnaithe?

entries.english: There is still something haunting about its presence...
entries.irish: Tá fós rud éigin haunting mar gheall ar a láithreacht...
Tá súil againn nach mbeidh sé snámh ar shiúl.

entries.english: A most peculiar creature, shaped by a most peculiar place.
entries.irish: Créatúr is peculiar, múnlaithe ag áit is peculiar.

entries.english: Loose folds of greenish skin gathered in around a pair of dark and hateful eyes.
entries.irish: Fillteán caillte de chraiceann greenish a bailíodh i thart ar péire de na súile dorcha agus hateful.

entries.english: Sometimes, you swear you can still hear its echoing laughter.
entries.irish: Uaireanta, swear tú is féidir leat a chloisteáil fós a gáire macalla.

entries.english: The huge grizzled head is as heavy as a boulder.
entries.irish: Is é an ceann grizzled ollmhór chomh trom mar bhollán.

entries.english: Praised for its strength, it lived only to defend its village.
entries.irish: Mholadh as a neart, bhí cónaí air ach amháin chun a sráidbhaile a chosaint.

entries.english:
The crownless head of a dead king.

Offer it to the Sacrificial Stones.
entries.irish:
An ceann crownless rí marbh.

Déan é a thairiscint do na Clocha Íobairt.

entries.english: Sometimes, the eyes still move and the lips mutter silently...
entries.irish: Uaireanta, na súile bogadh go fóill agus na liopaí mutter go ciúin...

entries.english: It shall cast no more spells against you.
entries.irish: Ní chaithfidh sé geasa níos mó in aghaidh leat.

entries.english: Even killing it couldn't wipe the knowing smile from its crooked lips...
entries.irish: Fiú marú ní fhéadfadh sé wipe an aoibh gháire a fhios agam as a liopaí cam...

entries.english: The mossy, severed head of a Greydwarf.
entries.irish: An ceann caonach, déine de Greydwarf.

entries.english: Woe be upon those who disturb their forests...
entries.irish: Mairg a bheith orthu siúd a cur isteach ar a gcuid foraoisí...

entries.english: It took seven blows to hack this gnarled head from its body.
entries.irish: Thóg sé seacht blows a hack an ceann gnarled as a chorp.

entries.english: Roots and stones, twisted by dark intents.
entries.irish: Roots agus clocha, twisted ag intinn dorcha.

entries.english: It may try to come back so be sure to prune any new shoots...
entries.irish: D'fhéadfadh sé iarracht teacht ar ais mar sin a bheith cinnte go prune aon shoots nua...

entries.english: Primal magic once coursed through it. Perhaps some still lingers...
entries.irish: Draíocht Primal le linn uair amháin tríd. B'fhéidir roinnt lingers fós...

entries.english: Whatever brought this creature to life is now long gone.
entries.irish: Cibé rud a thug an creature don saol anois imithe fada.

entries.english: These are said to bring luck. But not for their original owner.
entries.irish: Tá siad seo a rá a thabhairt luck. Ach ní le haghaidh a n-úinéir bunaidh.

entries.english: A rather odd animal, of both scale and fur.
entries.irish: Ainmhí sách corrach, ar scála agus fionnaidh araon.

entries.english: A young dragon – hopefully its mother will not seek vengeance.
entries.irish: A dragan óg – tá súil againn nach mbeidh a mháthair a lorg vengeance.

entries.english: Once a mighty warrior, now nought but a husk remains.
entries.irish: Nuair a ghaiscíoch mighty, anois nought ach fanann husk.

entries.english: A hardened soldier. What battles has he witnessed?
entries.irish: Saighdiúir cruaite. Cad iad na cathanna a chonaic sé?

entries.english: Before her death, her eyes sparked with magic. Now they're empty and void.
entries.irish: Roimh a bás, Sparked a súile le draíocht. Anois tá siad folamh agus ar neamhní.

entries.english: A powerful witch. What strange mysteries was she privy to?
entries.irish: Cailleach chumhachtach. Cad iad na mistéirí aisteacha a raibh sí ag príobháidiú chucu?

entries.english: Although slimy, the skin is beautifully patterned in red and black.
entries.irish: Cé go slimy, tá an craiceann álainne patterned i dearg agus dubh.

entries.english: A whole life spent in a dark swamp, now come to an untimely end.
entries.irish: A saol ar fad a chaitear i swamp dorcha, teacht anois chun deiridh anabaí.

entries.english: A giant beast's head, thatched with thick fur.
entries.irish: Ceann beithíoch ollmhór, tuí le fionnadh tiubh.

entries.english: A beast capable of both loyalty and destruction.
entries.irish: Beithíoch atá in ann dílseacht agus scrios araon a dhéanamh.

entries.english: Getting slashed by these claws would be very unpleasant.
entries.irish: Bheadh Getting slashed ag na crúba a bheith an-áitneamhach.

entries.english: This eyeless one shall dig no more.
entries.irish: Ní rachaidh an duine seo níos mó.

entries.english: The mighty ruler of the northern forests.
entries.irish: An rialóir mighty na foraoisí thuaidh.

entries.english: A majestic beast, and an iconic piece of decor.
entries.irish: Beithíoch maorga, agus píosa íocónach maisiúchán.

entries.english: The waking nightmare has met its end.
entries.irish: Tá an nightmare waking bhuail a deireadh.

entries.english: Only the most twisted of minds could summon such a creature.
entries.irish: Ach d'fhéadfadh an chuid is mó twisted aigne a thoghairm den sórt sin a creature.

entries.english: The beady eyes and razor sharp teeth belie the ostensibly calm nature of this small lizard.
entries.irish: Na súile beady agus fiacail géar rásúir belie an nádúr socair ostensibly an lizard beag.

entries.english: These creatures thrive in water, until a viking lands on their shores.
entries.irish: Na créatúir thrive in uisce, go dtí tailte inmharthana ar a gcladach.

entries.english: This animal never did any harm, yet it met an untimely end.
entries.irish: Ní raibh an t-ainmhí aon dochar, ach bhuail sé deireadh untimely.

entries.english: Those big, sad eyes stare back at you. What have you done?
entries.irish: Glacfar mór, súile brónach stare ar ais ag tú. Cad a rinne tú?

entries.english: The head of a fallen champion.
entries.irish: An ceann de curadh tar éis titim.

entries.english: The strongest of the brood, raised to be a mighty warrior.
entries.irish: An láidre an ál, ardaíodh a bheith ina laoch mighty.

entries.english: Less delicate than they look. The leather of the wings catches the firelight as if remembering flight.
entries.irish: Níos lú íogair ná mar a fhéachann siad. An leathar na sciatháin gabhálacha an tine mar má cuimhneamh eitilt.

entries.english: Relying on sound rather than sight, this creature was a most dangerous foe in the fog.
entries.irish: Ag brath ar fhuaim seachas radharc, bhí an créatúr foe is contúirtí sa ceo.

entries.english:
She has seen enough.

Offer it to the Sacrificial Stones.
entries.irish:
Tá sí le feiceáil go leor.

Déan é a thairiscint do na Clocha Íobairt.
Tá sí le feiceáil go leor.

entries.english: The scales have dulled but the eyes are still bright.
entries.irish: Tá na scálaí tar éis dul ach tá na súile fós geal.

entries.english: It ruled the seas unchallenged – until now.
entries.irish: Rialaigh sé na farraigí unchallenged – go dtí anois.

entries.english: This crystalline rock formation would make for an impressive floor decoration.
entries.irish: Bheadh an foirmiú carraig criostalach a dhéanamh le haghaidh maisiú urlár go hiontach.

entries.english: Rock and crystal, brought to life by ancient magic.
entries.irish: Rock agus criostail, a thabhairt ar an saol ag draíocht ársa.

entries.english: In the choice of 'ride or die', he picked the latter.
entries.irish: Sa rogha 'bród nó bás', phioc sé an dara ceann.

entries.english: The elder brother. Wished he had his brother's strength.
entries.irish: An deartháir elder. Wished bhí sé neart a dheartháir.

entries.english: The expressionless grin of this skull reminds you of the inevitability of death.
entries.irish: An grin expressionless an cloigeann gcuimhne duit ar an dosheachanta an bháis.

entries.english: Her rage burned so hot it stayed with her after death.
entries.irish: A rage dóite chomh te d'fhan sé léi tar éis bháis.

entries.english: It died and then rose again. Is this the fate that awaits you?
entries.irish: Fuair sé bás agus ansin d'ardaigh arís. An bhfuil sé seo an chinniúint go fanacht leat?
An bhfuil a fhios agat na buntáistí a bhaineann...

entries.english: A rank and rotten skull. You're not sure why you kept it...
entries.irish: A céim agus cloigeann lofa. Níl tú cinnte cén fáth ar choinnigh tú é...

entries.english: To end its lingering existence was most likely a mercy.
entries.irish: Chun deireadh a bheith ann lingering is dócha trócaire.

entries.english: Wreathed in pale flame, it still smoulders like an ember.
entries.irish: Wreathed i lasair pale, smoulders sé fós cosúil le ember.

entries.english: A fiendish creature, born of fire.
entries.irish: Créatúr fiendish, a rugadh de thine.

entries.english: Perhaps one of the most nasty things you have encountered. Fortunately, it's dead!
entries.irish: B'fhéidir ar cheann de na rudaí is olc agat a bhíonn. Fortunately, tá sé marbh!

entries.english: The leathery skin bears the faded tracery of ancient symbols.
entries.irish: Bears an craiceann leathair an rianaithe faded na siombailí ársa.

entries.english: Though this world is its domain, you have proven it can be defeated.
entries.irish: Cé go bhfuil an domhan a bhfearann, tá tú cruthaithe is féidir é a defeated.
Foinse do bhfianaise faoi stiúir glan

entries.english: A rugged tail from a not so good boy.
entries.irish: A eireaball garbh ó bhuachaill nach bhfuil chomh maith.

entries.english: Despite its bestial nature, there was something intelligent about it.
entries.irish: In ainneoin a nádúr bestial, bhí rud éigin cliste mar gheall air.

entries.english: It's like a vulture, but it thrives in volcanic climates.
entries.irish: Tá sé cosúil le vulture, ach thrives sé i climates bholcánach.

entries.english: Its watchful eyes still seem to search for cadavers to feast upon.
entries.irish: Is cosúil go bhfuil a súile watchful fós chun cuardach a dhéanamh ar cadavers chun feast ar.

entries.english: Frozen in death, the hair matted with blood and a silent howl lodged in its throat.
entries.irish: Frozen i bás, an ghruaig matted le fuil agus howl adh dtaiscfear ina scornach.

entries.english: This animal has the potential to be a viking's greatest friend – or their greatest enemy.
entries.irish: Tá an t-ainmhí an poitéinseal a bheith ina viking ar cara is mó - nó a namhaid is mó.

entries.english: The shed skin of a wraith, a flowing robe only visible by moonlight.
entries.irish: An craiceann a chaillfidh de wraith, gúna ag sileadh le feiceáil ach amháin ag moonlight.

entries.english: At last, this restless spirit has been set free.
entries.irish: Ag seo caite, tá an spiorad restless leagtha saor in aisce.

entries.english: Tough dead, it should probably be handled delicately.
entries.irish: Tough marbh, ba chóir é a láimhseáil dócha delicately.

entries.english: It remains dormant, at least for now...
entries.irish: Tá sé fós díomhaoin, ar a laghad le haghaidh anois...

entries.english: A dense vegetable, rich with nutrition.
These can be planted in cultivated soil.
entries.irish: Is féidir iad seo a chur in ithir saothraithe.

entries.english: Your attacker shall stand no chance as this missile finds its target.
entries.irish: Beidh do ionsaitheoir seasamh aon seans mar a fhaigheann an diúracán a sprioc.

entries.english: These thick missiles can punch through the hide of even the toughest foes.
entries.irish: Is féidir leis na diúracáin tiubh punch tríd an cheilt ar fiú na foes toughest.

entries.english: Forged from one of the hardest metals in all of Valheim, this missile is sure to hold off your enemies.
entries.irish: brionnaithe ó cheann de na miotail is deacra i ngach ceann de Valheim, tá an diúracán cinnte a shealbhú amach do naimhde.
An bhfuil a fhios agat na buntáistí a bhaineann...

entries.english: Sturdy wooden missiles that can provide a tough defense against foes.
entries.irish: Sturdy diúracáin adhmaid is féidir a chur ar fáil cosaint diana i gcoinne foes.

entries.english: This mysterious idol is brimming with the potential of the gods. It could grant a powerful boon, or demand a great sacrifice.
entries.irish: Tá an idol mistéireach brimming leis an acmhainneacht na déithe. D'fhéadfadh sé a dheonú boon cumhachtach, nó éileamh íobairt mór.

entries.english: A sweet and tasty treat, to celebrate a feat!
entries.irish: A chóireáil milis agus blasta, chun ceiliúradh a dhéanamh ar feat!

entries.english: These juicy berries are both sour and sweet.
entries.irish: Tá na caora juicy seo géar agus milis.

entries.english: Looks like they could crumble at any moment.
entries.irish: Breathnaíonn mar a d'fhéadfadh siad crumble ag am ar bith.

entries.english: These unassuming seeds can grow into vines that might overtake entire buildings.
entries.irish: Is féidir leis na síolta a glacadh ag fás i fíniúnacha a d'fhéadfadh a overtake foirgnimh ar fad.

entries.english: A chewy and somewhat dry meat. Some seasoning would probably make it taste better, but it'll fill your stomach regardless.
entries.irish: Feoil chewy agus beagán tirim. Bheadh roinnt seasoning dhéanamh dócha go bhfuil sé blas níos fearr, ach beidh sé a líonadh do boilg beag beann.

entries.english: Given that this bird feasts on all kinds of things, you'd better cook its meat before you even think about eating it.
entries.irish: Ós rud é go féastaí éan seo ar gach cineál rudaí, ba mhaith leat cócaireacht níos fearr a fheoil sula gceapann tú fiú faoi é a ithe.

entries.english: Warm to the touch, and full of protein.
entries.irish: Téamh leis an dteagmháil, agus iomlán de próitéin.

entries.english: This ancient bone remembers the location of many forgotten things.
entries.irish: Cuimhníonn an cnámh ársa an suíomh go leor rudaí dearmad.

entries.english: A giant bone, knotted like old wood.
entries.irish: Cnámh ollmhór, snaidhmthe cosúil le sean - adhmad.

entries.english: It is hard and sharp like iron.
entries.irish: Tá sé crua agus géar cosúil le iarainn.

entries.english: A bundle of thick, rough hair. It has a strong smell.
entries.irish: Beart de ghruaig thiubh, gharbh. Tá boladh láidir air.

entries.english: Good, strong wood to build with.
entries.irish: Dea, adhmad láidir a thógáil leis.

entries.english: The gnarled body parts of a strange, offputting creature.
entries.irish: Na codanna comhlacht gnarled de aisteach, aschur creature.

entries.english: The remains of Yagluth, a twisted spirit torn between this world and the next.
entries.irish: An iarsmaí de Yagluth, torn spiorad twisted idir an saol seo agus an chéad cheann eile.

entries.english: Made with sap from the great tree. Even a mouthful imparts a warm glow to your whole body.
entries.irish: Déanta le holc ón gcrann mór. Fiú mouthful Tugann glow te do chorp ar fad.

entries.english: Godflesh, wood from the Great Tree.
entries.irish: Godflesh, adhmad as an Crann Mór.

entries.english: The earthy remains of the giant Ymir.
entries.irish: Tá an t-ollmhór fós ar an Ymir ollmhór.
